facts.fact: Universal Ads announced that it now accepts American Express Cards through a new collaboration with American Express.
facts.quote: Through a new collaboration between Universal Ads and American Express, Universal Ads now accepts American Express® Cards.

facts.fact: According to Universal Ads, American Express Card Members can use their Cards to reach millions of viewers across many top streaming networks.
